name: ColorInput

examples.title: Swatches
examples.code:
<ColorInput
  label="Label color"
  format="hex"
  closeOnSwatchClick
  swatches={[
    { color: '#1e6b99', label: 'Ocean' },
    { color: '#00d1b2', label: 'Turquoise' },
    { color: '#ff6685', label: 'Pink' },
    { color: '#ffdd57', label: 'Sunflower' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Controlled, and Theming With It
In a Form
examples.code:
<form onSubmit={event => event.preventDefault()}>
  <ColorInput label="Calendar color" name="calendarColor" required />
  <ColorInput label="Locked" disabled defaultValue="#ff6685" />
</form>

examples.title: Sizes and Colors
examples.code:
<>
  <ColorInput label="Small" size="small" isRounded defaultValue="#00d1b2" />
  <ColorInput label="Large" size="large" color="info" defaultValue="#1e6b99" />
</>

examples.title: Right to Left
examples.code:
<LocaleProvider locale="ar" dir="rtl">
  <ColorInput
    label="اللون"
    defaultValue="hsl(150, 60%, 40%)"
    labels={{ chooseColor: 'اختر لونًا' }}
  />
</LocaleProvider>

accessibility:
- **The field is a combobox that opens a dialog**, as the date pickers' is: `role="combobox"`,
  `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, named by its `label`. The
  launcher is a button named "Choose color" with the same attributes.
- **Keys in the field:** Alt+ArrowDown opens the panel; Enter commits typed text; Escape puts
  typed text back without closing a `Modal` around the field.
- **The panel** is a non-modal `dialog` named "Choose color" that holds focus while it's open.
  Focus starts on the saturation and brightness square, and Escape, Alt+ArrowUp or a press
  outside closes it and hands focus back to the field.
- **The square and the sliders** are `ColorPicker`'s: native range inputs, the square one 2D
  slider with one tab stop. See [`ColorPicker`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/form/colorpicker#accessibility).
- **The swatch in the field** is for the pointer only: it's hidden from assistive tech and takes
  no tab stop, since the launcher does the same from the keyboard.
- **The value is always text** in the field, and text it can't read is marked `aria-invalid`.
- **Forced colors:** the swatch keeps its color with an edge in the system's text color.
- **Strings** come from `labels`, with English defaults.
summary: The `ColorInput` component is a form field for a color: type it, or open a color picker from its launcher or its swatch. The value is a CSS color string, HSL by default, or empty. The panel is the `ColorPicker`'s square, hue slider and, when asked for, alpha slider, swatches and eye dropper, in the same popover the date pickers use.

parts.summary: The `ColorInput` component is a form field for a color: type it, or open a color picker from its launcher or its swatch. The value is a CSS color string, HSL by default, or empty. The panel is the `ColorPicker`'s square, hue slider and, when asked for, alpha slider, swatches and eye dropper, in the same popover the date pickers use.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label (component auto-wraps in a `Field` if not already inside). Automatically associated with the text field via `htmlFor`, using your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Dropped inside an outer `Field`, whose own label associates instead when that `Field` generates a target id (not `grouped`/`hasAddons`, no explicit `labelProps.htmlFor`) and you set no `id` here.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Render the field with horizontal layout.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner on the `Control` it renders, and hides the launcher (`triggerIcon`) while it does. Inside your own `Control` it renders none, so this draws nothing and warns in development; set `isLoading` on that `Control`.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Shows the launcher on the field's end that toggles the panel. Hidden by default while a spinner shows at the same edge: this component's `isLoading` when it renders its own `Control`, or the enclosing `Control`'s `isLoading` inside one.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Expand the control to fill its container.

props.name: controlSize
props.description: Size of the wrapping Control.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation text below the field.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Color modifier for the help message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Control wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: The color, controlled, as a CSS color the picker reads (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()` or a color name), or `''` for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color to start with, uncontrolled; empty without one.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the color, in `format`, as it changes: on every step of a drag in the panel, on a key or a swatch, and when typed text is committed. Clearing the field calls it with `''`.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called with the color, in `format`, once a change is done: when a drag ends, and with `onChange` for everything else. The place to save it.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is written: `'hsl'` (`hsl(171, 100%, 41%)`), `'hex'` or `'rgb'`, with alpha as `hsla()`, `#rrggbbaa` and `rgba()`. Typed text in any of them is written back in this one.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Adds an alpha slider to the panel and writes the alpha into the value.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors in the panel: a list of CSS colors, each a string or `{ color, label }`, or `"bulma"` for the page's theme colors.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Adds a button to the panel that picks a color from anywhere on the screen, where the browser has the EyeDropper API.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when the panel opens.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the panel closes.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Opens the panel when the field takes focus, and moves focus into it. Off by default, since typing a value is the quick way in and the launcher, a click on the swatch or Alt+ArrowDown open it.

props.name: closeOnSwatchClick
props.description: Closes the panel once a swatch is chosen.

props.name: position
props.description: The panel's place relative to the field.

props.name: appendToBody
props.description: Renders the panel through a portal, into the `portalContainer` a `ConfigProvider` sets, `document.body` by default.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the field.

props.name: size
props.description: The field's size.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Renders the field with rounded ends.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and its panel. A disabled `Fieldset` does too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the field read-only, with no panel.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

props.name: triggerIconName
props.description: The launcher's glyph.

props.name: labels
props.description: The strings it says, each with an English default.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

extraProps.name: name
extraProps.description: Form field name. The field submits the text it shows, the value in `format`, or nothing when it's empty.

extraProps.name: required
extraProps.description: Marks the field required, so an empty one fails the form's constraint validation.

parts.catchAll: All standard <input> attributes and Bulma helper props
parts.helperPropsNote: Helper props go on the `.colorinput` `<div>`, with `className`. The other attributes go on the text `<input>`.
